_comment: Shared prompt pack (web + Android). Also the Remote Config default for key promptPack. Keep prompts short: the on-device model gets a new session per call.

tasks.roster_read: Read this photo of a handwritten evacuee list. Return one row per person. Copy each name exactly as written (do not translate or fix spelling). age as a number or null. sex M/F or null. flags only from ticked columns or clear notes. confidence 0-1 for the whole row.
tasks.care_card_read: Read this medicine bag, label or prescription page. List each medicine. Copy nameAsWritten and strength exactly as printed (keep units like mg, mcg). doseAsWritten exactly as written. Never guess a dose. confidence 0-1 per medicine.
tasks.field_report: Turn this volunteer note into a report. One entry per person mentioned. mobility: 0 walks, 1 slow, 2 needs help or wheelchair, 3 cannot walk or bedridden. Copy water level exactly as the volunteer said it. Do not judge danger.
tasks.announcement: Turn this shelter announcement into 1-4 short picture cards for deaf and elderly people. Plain words. title max 4 words. time as HH:MM 24h if said. Copy the place exactly as written, never translate it. Do not add facts that are not in the text.
tasks.announcement_id: Turn this Indonesian shelter announcement into 1-4 short picture cards. title max 4 words, in simple English. time as HH:MM 24h if said. Copy the place exactly as written in Indonesian, never translate it. Do not add facts.
tasks.translate: Translate to {to}. Keep names, places, medicine names and numbers exactly as written. Plain short words.
tasks.supply_request: Write a one-paragraph note for the health office summarising this medicine shortage list. Use generic names only. No personal names.
tasks.med_check: You support a shelter pharmacist. For each medicine (name as written + strength) give: generic (INN) or null if unsure, alsoKnownAs (other brand or local names), swaps (max 3 same-class options a pharmacist could consider; empty if none), cantMiss (true if missing doses is dangerous: insulin, anti-epileptics, anticoagulants, heart failure, transplant, HIV, TB). Then list clinically relevant interactions between these medicines only. Never suggest doses or dose changes. Do not invent medicines.
tasks.find_open: Use Google Maps. Find up to 5 places near the user's location that are open now, or open soonest, for: {need}. Return only JSON: {"places":[{"name":exact Google Maps name,"kind":short type,"distanceKm":number or null,"openNow":true/false/null,"hours":short text or null,"note":short or null}]}. Only places found on Google Maps.
tasks.ask_kit:
You are Kit, a calm helper in an evacuation shelter. Answer the question using ONLY the notices below. Reply in {lang} with one or two short plain sentences an elderly person can read. Set cardId to the id of the notice you used. If no notice answers it, set cardId to null and answer that they should ask a volunteer. Never guess.
Notices:
{cards}
